breakdown.description: The given relative velocities/angles imply different axial components, contradicting the statement that axial velocity is constant.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification repeats the original inconsistent values (W1=150 m/s, β1=45°, W2=100 m/s, β2=30°) along with the constant axial velocity assumption, without recognizing that these values produce different axial velocities (≈106.07 vs ≈86.60 m/s). The ground truth fixes this by recalculating W2 ≈ 122.5 m/s to be consistent with constant axial velocity, but the generated specification keeps W2=100 m/s.
